A noon speakeasy 👍🏼
Sep 2026 • Solo
Decided to come here for drinks & some lunch on a Monday. Amazing cocktails. The lady bartender knows her drinks. Both her t recommendations hit the spot. Recommend the Origin 1982 if you like a smoky drink & the Balut if you’d like South-East Asian flavors - it was like a laksa in a drink (spicy with the chilli/laksa leaves & refreshing with the lime). Super good! Food was snacking - a deconstructed bank mi made for easy eating. The clam chowder was not bad too. Definitely a place I’d come again. Turn right & walk a short distance up the hill right after Xom. Decor was that of a speakeasy.
